actors.name: Amara
actors.private_context: Amara is an employee who wants to be respected by her coworkers. She has no specific plan to change their perception.

actors.name: Coworkers
actors.private_context: The coworkers are a group of people who work with Amara. They have their own opinions and perceptions of Amara, which may change over time based on her actions.

shared_context: Amara and her coworkers work together in the same organization. The quarter runs from October 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026. Respect is subjective and may be inferred from coworkers' behavior or statements.

starting_events.description: The quarter begins. Amara and her coworkers are at work.

resolution: Resolve YES only if, by 2026-12-31T17:00:00-04:00, there is observable evidence (e.g., coworkers explicitly stating increased respect, deferring to Amara's opinions, or seeking her input more frequently) that indicates a net increase in respect from the coworkers toward Amara compared to the start. Otherwise resolve NO.
